observation.command: cd /workspace/deployment && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml ps --format '{{.Name}} {{.Status}}' | sort; echo "---"; docker exec qonnectra_db_dev psql -U qonnectra_user -d qonnectra -tAc "SELECT string_agg(extname,', ') FROM pg_extension WHERE extname IN ('postgis','pgrouting','dblink','pgcrypto');"
